name: How much does it cost to replace countertops in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace countertops in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of countertop replacement in Berkeley varies depending on the material, complexity of the installation, and the size of your kitchen. Entry-level laminate can be more affordable, while high-end natural stone like marble or granite will be a higher investment. Additional costs may include old countertop removal, sink cutouts, and specialized edge profiles. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
